description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between different word sequences on the x-axis and corresponding ASR values on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled "words" and displays categorical values: "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderfully", "brilliant", and "stunningly". The y-axis is labeled "ASR", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.2 to 0.9, and does not include units. 

A teal line with circular markers begins at approximately 0.42 when x equals "bb", increases to a peak of 0.86 when x equals "beautiful", then decreases to 0.76 when x equals "stunningly". An orange line with 'x' markers starts at approximately 0.1 when x equals "bb", increases to a peak of 0.68 when x equals "excellent", then declines to 0.58 when x equals "stunningly". A purple line with square markers begins at approximately 0.82 when x equals "bb", decreases to a low of 0.59 when x equals "cf", then increases to 0.81 when x equals "stunningly".
